LESSON: USHAIRI

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: KUKABILIANA NA UMASKINI Mada Mada Ndogo Matokeo Maalum Yanayotarajiwa Shughuli z
Topic 6.1.1: Ushairi

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo ni somo la kusoma: Ushairi. Soma maelezo, fuata mifano iliyofanyiwa kazi, kisha fanya mazoezi.

SEHEMU 2: MALENGO

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. explain what Ushairi means in simple pupil language
2. give 3 correct examples of Ushairi from Kenya
3. practise Ushairi in clear steps
4. apply Ushairi in one real-life situation this week

SEHEMU 3: SOMO (MAELEZO NA MIFANO)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: USHAIRI
Subject: KISWAHILI · Grade: Grade 5
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Ushairi helps you succeed in KISWAHILI. You will understand it, practise it, and use it nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

KEY FACTS: USHAIRI
Study Ushairi like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Explain what Ushairi means in simple pupil language

What this means
In this part you learn to explain what Ushairi means in simple pupil language. You will use ideas from nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain what Ushairi means in simple pupil language.
2. Soma, sema, kisha andika using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Mfano wa kusoma: Soma sentensi fupi kuhusu “Ushairi”, kisha eleza kwa maneno yako.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain what Ushairi means in simple pupil language. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Give 3 correct examples of Ushairi from Kenya

What this means
In this part you learn to give 3 correct examples of Ushairi from Kenya. You will use ideas from nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: give 3 correct examples of Ushairi from Kenya.
2. Soma, sema, kisha andika using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Mfano wa kuzungumza: Zungumza na rafiki kwa dakika 1 kuhusu Ushairi.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can give 3 correct examples of Ushairi from Kenya. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Practise Ushairi in clear steps

What this means
In this part you learn to practise Ushairi in clear steps. You will use ideas from nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: practise Ushairi in clear steps.
2. Soma, sema, kisha andika using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Mfano wa kuandika: Andika sentensi 3 sahihi kuhusu Ushairi.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can practise Ushairi in clear steps. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 4: Apply Ushairi in one real-life situation this week

What this means
In this part you learn to apply Ushairi in one real-life situation this week. You will use ideas from nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: apply Ushairi in one real-life situation this week.
2. Soma, sema, kisha andika using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Mfano wa kusoma: Soma sentensi fupi kuhusu “Ushairi”, kisha eleza kwa maneno yako.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can apply Ushairi in one real-life situation this week. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Ushairi is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO YA HARAKA

Example 1: Soma sentensi fupi kuhusu “Ushairi”, kisha eleza kwa maneno yako. (skill: explain what Ushairi means in simple pupil language)

Example 2: Zungumza na rafiki kwa dakika 1 kuhusu Ushairi. (skill: give 3 correct examples of Ushairi from Kenya)

Example 3: Andika sentensi 3 sahihi kuhusu Ushairi. (skill: practise Ushairi in clear steps)

Example 4: Soma sentensi fupi kuhusu “Ushairi”, kisha eleza kwa maneno yako. (skill: apply Ushairi in one real-life situation this week)

SEHEMU 5: MAZOEZI

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Ushairi to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: explain what Ushairi means in simple pupil language.
3. Practise this skill: give 3 correct examples of Ushairi from Kenya.
4. Practise this skill: practise Ushairi in clear steps.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Ushairi from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA NYUMBANI

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Ushairi: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 5 learner study Ushairi?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. Know what Ushairi means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: explain what Ushairi means in simple pupil language.
5. Be able to: give 3 correct examples of Ushairi from Kenya.

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
